title: The Anatomy of a Short Squeeze
summary: A fictional short seller gets a late-night margin call and races back to the exchange.

scenes.label: The call
scenes.headline: His phone lights up
scenes.narration: His phone lights up. Buy the stock back, or put up more cash.

scenes.label: Earlier that day
scenes.headline: A share changes hands
scenes.narration: Hours earlier, he borrowed one share from a broker. He has to give it back.

scenes.label: The sale
scenes.headline: A buyer pays twenty dollars
scenes.narration: He sells it for twenty dollars. The plan is to buy another share for less.

scenes.label: Illustrative trade
scenes.headline: The exchange fills up
scenes.narration: But buyers pile in. Twenty becomes thirty-five. Then fifty.

scenes.label: The loss
scenes.headline: Thirty dollars short
scenes.narration: To replace that share at fifty, his twenty dollars is thirty short, before fees.

scenes.label: The margin call
scenes.headline: The broker calls for collateral
scenes.narration: The broker wants more collateral. He can put up the cash, or close the trade.

scenes.label: The run
scenes.headline: Back to the exchange
scenes.narration: He can't post the cash. So he runs to buy a share.

scenes.label: The auction
scenes.headline: A bid at fifty dollars
scenes.narration: He buys it back at fifty. Other short sellers are trying to do the same thing.

scenes.label: The squeeze
scenes.headline: One bid sets off the next
scenes.narration: Their buy orders can lift the price again. That puts more shorts under pressure, and some of them buy too.

scenes.label: GameStop
scenes.headline: The SEC examines January 2021
scenes.narration: In January twenty twenty-one, GameStop short interest topped its public float. The report found broader buying sustained the rally.

scenes.label: The return
scenes.headline: The share goes back to the broker
scenes.narration: When a short seller has to buy, a bet against the stock can help push it up.
